acknowledgement.text:
Sign in with your Claude account (Pro or Max) for your own, personal use.

claude-multi is an independent tool, not affiliated with Anthropic. Anthropic's terms say third
parties may not "offer Claude.ai login into their own applications", "route requests through
Free, Pro, or Max plan credentials on behalf of their users", or "collect, store, or
intermediate Claude.ai credentials or session tokens". Signing in here stores your own
account's tokens on this computer for your own sessions only. An Anthropic API key is the
supported alternative.

This sign-in is separate from your Claude Code login, which stays untouched.
